name: vscode-projects-dock-companion
description: Silent reporter: publishes this window's identity and liveness to the shared state directory the PowerToys dock reads. Reports what is, never what to do.
author: Michael Bolli <michael@bolli.us>
// extensionKind: Phase 0 confirmed a ui-host extension sees the wsl+ authority and writes natively to %LOCALAPPDATA%.

commands.title: VS Code Projects Dock: Show companion status

vscodeProjectsDock.heartbeatIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often (in milliseconds) this window rewrites its state file so the dock sees the window as alive. Lower = snappier dock updates but more disk writes. The dock's staleness/reap threshold should be a small multiple of this (the default reap of 6s tolerates one missed 2s beat). Minimum 500.

vscodeProjectsDock.sharedDirectory.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the shared state directory both halves use. Leave empty to use the default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VsCodeProjectsDock\windows`. **If you change this, the dock must be configured to read the same path.**
